node.title: Re^3: How do I make a tcp socket heartbeat?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I used IO :: Socket because I found the most examples out there, but I found it very difficult to understand how everything works with it.

Yes, the [man://select;2|select(2)] system call is (one of) the classic ways to do it. "Classic" both in the good and bad sense: good because understanding it will help you understand how lots of servers work and how things work on a lower level, not so good because nowadays I'd consider it fairly low level, so for just getting stuff done, as I said IMHO event loops are a good approach.
